Rector.title: Rector
Rector.name: Abdishukur Narmatov
Rector.message: In the Quran, Almighty Allah says: “Allah will raise in درجات those among you who believe and those who have been given knowledge...”. Our Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “The scholars are the heirs of the prophets.” The high rank of scholars is tied to their role in uniting the Muslim community, keeping it from straying from the right path, and guiding it toward the path to Paradise. The primary duty of scholars is to preserve harmony among people and strengthen their unity. Throughout human history, no matter how many prophets came, their mission was always to unite people. May Almighty Allah make us steadfast in His religion and among those who guide others to the right path.

sections.title: General information about scientific activity
sections.description:
The scientific activity of Kyrgyzstan Islamic University is an integral part of the educational process and is aimed at developing Islamic and humanities scholarship, as well as training highly qualified specialists.

At KIU, research is conducted on the principles of academic integrity, scientific objectivity, Islamic ethics, and service to society. The university creates conditions for the active involvement of faculty and students in research activities.

sections.title: Main research areas
sections.description: Research at Kyrgyzstan Islamic University is carried out in the following priority areas:
items: Islamic theology and Aqeedah;
Arabic philology and linguistics;
Islamic law (fiqh) and comparative legal studies;
Islamic history and Muslim culture;
religious studies and interfaith dialogue;
pedagogy and methodology of religious education;
spiritual and moral development of youth.

sections.title: Research work
sections.description:
Kyrgyzstan Islamic University carries out planned and initiative-based research conducted by faculty members and students.

Research is aimed at developing Islamic sciences, addressing urgent issues of modern society, and integrating research results into the educational process.

sections.title: Scientific publications (publication activity)
sections.description: The KIU faculty publishes academic works in the following formats:
items: research articles;
monographs;
textbooks and teaching guides;
scientific conference proceedings.
sections.note: Scientific publications are an important indicator for assessing the effectiveness of the university's research activity.

sections.title: Scientific events
sections.description: Kyrgyzstan Islamic University organizes and holds the following events aimed at developing research potential and exchanging experience:
items: scientific and practical conferences;
seminars;
round tables;
academic discussions.
sections.note: The outcomes of these events are published in the form of reports and collected materials.

sections.title: Student research activity
sections.description:
Student research work is an important part of the educational process at Kyrgyzstan Islamic University.

Students are involved in scientific activity through the following formats:
items: participation in research clubs;
completion of research projects;
participation in conferences and competitions;
publication of research articles.

sections.title: Scientific cooperation
sections.description:
Kyrgyzstan Islamic University develops scientific cooperation with educational, research, and religious organizations.

Cooperation is carried out in the following areas:
items: joint research projects;
participation in scientific events;
exchange of experience and academic information;
implementation of joint projects.

sections.title: Science news
sections.description: This section publishes information about the university's scientific achievements, publications by faculty and students, participation in conferences, and other science-related news.

HistoryPage.title: University History
HistoryPage.introduction: Kyrgyzstan Islamic University is a higher educational institution under the Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Kyrgyzstan, where Islamic values and Sharia principles are taught on an academic basis. In the early 1990s, the head of Kyrgyzstan's religious administration, Kimsanbay Azhy Abdrakhmanov, proposed opening an Islamic madrasa in Bishkek. As a result, at the beginning of 1991, the Islamic madrasa named after Hazreti Umar was opened in Bishkek.
HistoryPage.mission: The mission of Kyrgyzstan Islamic University is to provide competitive education and scientific research based on the achievements of science, innovation, and technology for the sustainable development of the religious sphere, while strengthening the moral, aesthetic, and cultural values of society.
HistoryPage.history:
The madrasa, which followed the right path of development, quickly evolved and in 1993 became the Islamic Institute named after Hazreti Umar under the Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Kyrgyzstan. Having earned considerable authority among the Muslim community of the country, the institute received university status by the decision of the Second Congress of Muslims of Kyrgyzstan and the Council of Ulema on April 25, 2003, and was renamed Kyrgyzstan Islamic University. While the madrasa had only 4 teachers, by the institute period, in 1998, it already had 25 teachers and more than 280 students. Today, the university employs 72 teachers, and more than 1,000 students from different regions of the country and from abroad study there. The teaching staff currently includes doctors of science and professors.

In 2017, the university received a license from the Ministry of Education and Science of the Kyrgyz Republic for the Theology program, and in 2018 for the Arabic Philology program. At present, under the Faculty of Humanities Education, the departments of Theology, Natural and Humanitarian Disciplines, and Arabic Philology operate in accordance with state standards. In addition, the Sharia Department, the Bishkek Quran Course, and the Osh Quran Center train religious specialists who follow the authentic and moderate tradition inherited from our ancestors. As the flagship among religious educational institutions in Kyrgyzstan, Kyrgyzstan Islamic University continues to prepare highly educated professionals and qualified specialists for the Islamic sphere. Graduates of the university successfully work in all areas of religious service, as well as in higher education institutions and embassies, carry out spiritual outreach, and contribute to the development of the state.

sections.title: General information for applicants
sections.description:
Kyrgyzstan Islamic University invites applicants to study in higher education programs that combine classical university education with the spiritual and moral values of Islam.

Education at the university is aimed at developing professional competencies, academic culture, responsibility, and respect for the traditional values of society.

sections.title: Educational programs
sections.description: Kyrgyzstan Islamic University offers the following educational programs:
items: Theology;
Arabic Philology;
Sharia.
sections.note: Each program specifies the level of education, mode and duration of study, as well as the qualification awarded.

sections.title: Admission rules
sections.description: Admission to Kyrgyzstan Islamic University is carried out in accordance with the admission rules approved annually.
sections.note: The admission rules are published in open access and include the document submission procedure, enrollment conditions, and requirements for applicants.

sections.title: Entrance examinations
sections.description: To enter the university, applicants take entrance examinations in the form of testing and/or an interview according to the selected educational program.

sections.title: Admission timeline
sections.description: The deadlines for document submission, entrance examinations, and enrollment are approved annually and published on the university's official website.

sections.title: Tuition fees
sections.description: Tuition fees are determined for each educational program separately and approved by the rector's order.

sections.title: Admissions office contacts
sections.description: The admissions office of Kyrgyzstan Islamic University provides consultations on enrollment matters.
sections.note: The address, phone numbers, email, and office hours of the admissions office are published on the university's website.

TheologyFacultyPage.title: Theology Department
TheologyFacultyPage.professorsEmpty: No department faculty members have been added yet.

sections.title: General information
sections.description:
On April 12, 2017, the State Commission for Religious Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic issued certificate No. 0382-RUZ, granting the right to provide higher religious education. In addition, on July 7, 2017, based on order No. 936/1 of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Kyrgyz Republic, license No. LD170001294 was issued to conduct educational activities (code: 531600 – Theology).

Based on this license, the Department of Theology and Natural-Humanitarian Disciplines was established to implement the educational program 531600 – Theology, and student instruction in the specialty 531600 – Theology began in accordance with the State Educational Standard.

As a result, for the first time in the university’s history, it became possible to organize the educational process on the basis of a state license, and in the 2017–2018 academic year 50 students were admitted to the first year. In 2018, the Department of Theology and Natural-Humanitarian Disciplines was reorganized and renamed the Theology Department.

Currently, 267 students are studying in the 531600 – Theology educational program.

sections.title: Department mission
sections.description: The mission of the Theology Department is to provide religious education based on state educational standards, improve religious literacy in society, strengthen tolerance and interfaith harmony, and prepare responsible, modern, and competitive theology specialists who preserve spiritual and moral values.

sections.title: Department goals
sections.description: The main goals of the department are as follows:
items: to train highly qualified specialists within the framework of the 531600 – Theology educational program;
to raise students’ scientific, theoretical, and practical knowledge through the integration of religious, philosophical, and humanitarian sciences;
to develop students’ ability to analyze religious texts scientifically, think critically, and conduct research;
to educate specialists who correctly understand religious issues in society and are capable of resisting radicalism and extremism;
to prepare citizens who preserve spiritual, moral, national, and universal values;
to develop research activities and continuously improve the quality of education.

sections.title: Main activities of the department
sections.description: The main activities of the Theology Department include the following areas:
items: organizing and conducting the educational process for the 531600 – Theology program in accordance with the State Educational Standard of the Kyrgyz Republic;
delivering lectures, seminars, and practical classes in theology, religious studies, philosophy, and the humanities;
developing and updating curricula, teaching and methodological complexes, syllabi, and educational programs;
organizing students’ research work and supervising course papers and final qualification theses;
developing the research activities of the faculty, preparing and publishing scientific articles, textbooks, and teaching manuals;
organizing scientific and practical conferences, seminars, round tables, and educational events;
conducting educational work aimed at improving religious literacy, strengthening interfaith harmony, and preventing religious extremism;
developing cooperation with state bodies, religious organizations, research institutions, and educational institutions;
carrying out students’ moral and educational development and shaping spiritual and ethical values;
supporting graduates’ successful adaptation to the labor market and ensuring their practical training.

sections.title: Department leadership
sections.description: The department has been headed since 2021 by PhD in theology Sultanbek Dzholmatovich Tashmatov.

sections.title: Graduate qualification
sections.description: A graduate who successfully completes the 531600 – Theology educational program is awarded the qualification of theologian (bachelor).

sections.title: Graduate career fields
sections.description: Graduates of the Theology specialty can work in the following institutions and organizations:
items: in religious educational institutions (madrasa, school, religious college, and higher education institutions) as teachers or specialists;
in the State Commission for Religious Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic and its regional divisions;
in the muftiate, kaziyats, religious organizations, and confessional institutions as specialists or consultants;
in state bodies and local self-government bodies as specialists on religious issues;
in public and non-governmental organizations (in the areas of improving religious literacy and preventing extremism);
in research institutions and analytical centers;
in mass media as experts or analysts on religious issues;
in institutions focused on education, enlightenment, and social work.

sections.title: Objects of professional activity
sections.description: The objects of graduates’ professional activity include the following:
items: religious teachings, religious texts, and their historical and theoretical analysis;
the relationship between religion and society;
interfaith relations;
issues of religious security and social stability.

PhilologyFacultyPage.title: Arabic Philology Department
PhilologyFacultyPage.professorsEmpty: No department faculty members have been added yet.

sections.title: General information
sections.description:
On April 12, 2018, the State Commission for Religious Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic issued certificate No. 0382-RUZ, granting the right to provide higher religious education. In addition, on April 2, 2018, based on order No. 388/1 of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Kyrgyz Republic, license No. LD180000156 was issued to conduct educational activities (code: 531000 – Philology (Arabic Philology)).

Based on this license, the Arabic Philology Department was established to implement the educational program 531000 – Philology (Arabic Philology), and student training began in accordance with the State Educational Standard of the Kyrgyz Republic.

As a result, in the 2018–2019 academic year 50 students were admitted to the first year, and the department began conducting the educational process within the Faculty of Humanities. At present, 190 students are studying in the 531000 – Arabic Philology educational program.

sections.title: Department mission
sections.description: The mission of the Arabic Philology Department is to train specialists who have deep knowledge of the Arabic language, literature, and culture, possess modern philological education, multilingual competence, and competitiveness, and who contribute to the development of interlingual and intercultural ties.

sections.title: Department goals
sections.description: The main goals of the department are as follows:
items: to train highly qualified philology specialists within the framework of the 531000 – Philology (Arabic Philology) educational program;
to develop students’ language and communicative competencies through modern methods of teaching Arabic;
to master the theoretical foundations of Arabic literature, linguistics, and culture;
to develop students’ skills in translation, text analysis, and research work;
to educate specialists who preserve national and universal values and are capable of intercultural dialogue;
to improve the quality of education and intensify research activities.

sections.title: Main activities of the department
sections.description: The main activities of the Arabic Philology Department include the following areas:
items: organizing and conducting the educational process for the 531000 – Philology (Arabic Philology) program in accordance with the State Educational Standard of the Kyrgyz Republic;
conducting lectures, seminars, and practical classes in the Arabic language, Arabic literature, linguistics, and the humanities;
developing and updating curricula, teaching and methodological complexes, syllabi, and educational programs;
organizing students’ research work and supervising course papers and final qualification theses;
developing the research activities of the faculty, preparing scientific articles and teaching materials;
organizing scientific and practical conferences, seminars, and round tables;
conducting linguistic and cultural educational events;
developing cooperation with state, educational, and international organizations;
carrying out educational work with students and ensuring their practical training;
supporting graduates’ successful adaptation to the labor market.

sections.title: Department leadership
sections.description: The Arabic Philology Department has been headed since the second half of the 2021–2022 academic year by acting department head Azamat Shamshiev.

sections.title: Graduate qualification
sections.description: A graduate who successfully completes the 531000 – Philology (Arabic Philology) educational program is awarded the qualification of philologist (bachelor).

sections.title: Graduate career fields
sections.description: Graduates of the Arabic Philology specialty can work in the following institutions and organizations:
items: in general education schools, colleges, and higher education institutions as teachers;
in language courses and educational centers;
in translation bureaus and international organizations as translators;
in state institutions and diplomatic services as specialists;
in mass media and publishing houses;
in research institutions;
in cultural and educational organizations.

sections.title: Objects of professional activity
sections.description: The objects of graduates’ professional activity include the following:
items: the Arabic language and its dialects;
Arabic literature and texts;
the relationship between language and culture;
translation activity and interlingual communication.

ShariaFacultyPage.title: Sharia Department
ShariaFacultyPage.professorsEmpty: No department faculty members have been added yet.

sections.title: General information
items: As a structural division of Kyrgyzstan Islamic University, the Sharia Department implements higher religious education in the field of religious studies.
The department is subordinate to the Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Kyrgyzstan.
It operates in accordance with the standards and requirements established by the relevant institutions.
It awards diplomas of the Spiritual Administration model.

sections.title: Key features
items: Leadership: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Kyrgyzstan (Muftiate).
Faculty: classes are taught by the country’s leading religious figures and distinguished scholars.
Tuition fee: lower compared with other religious educational institutions.
Uniqueness: the only university in the country providing education in a religious specialty.
Location: in the center of the capital city.
Scope of activity: the educational process is conducted within the framework of Maturidi creed and Hanafi madhhab.

sections.title: Department mission
sections.description: To teach the foundations of Sharia and religious knowledge on a scientific basis within the framework of the Maturidi creed and Hanafi madhhab, preparing deeply knowledgeable, ethical, and socially responsible specialists. To strengthen interfaith harmony and prevent radicalism.

sections.title: Department goals
items: to educate qualified specialists through the comprehensive study of fiqh, usul al-fiqh, and Sharia law;
to combine Sharia with modern law and humanitarian disciplines;
to develop the ability to analyze religious sources;
to intensify research and improve the quality of education;
to foster spirituality, moral values, and professional ethics;
to strengthen cooperation with relevant institutions and organizations.

sections.title: Graduate qualification
sections.description:
A bachelor’s degree in Sharia is awarded.

Competencies: source analysis, Sharia assessment, and analytical work.

sections.title: Graduate career fields
items: Religious educational institutions / teacher, specialist
Spiritual Administration and all its structures / religious officer
State bodies / expert in religious and legal matters
Public organizations / educator, anti-extremism work
Research centers, media / researcher, analyst
Consulting / religious advisor on fatwas, family issues, and other matters

sections.title: General Provisions
sections.description: The Human Resources Department is a structural unit of the university and reports to the university rector. In its activities, it is guided by the legislation of the Kyrgyz Republic, regulatory documents of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Kyrgyz Republic, the university charter, as well as local regulatory acts, orders and directives of the rector in force at the university.

sections.title: Responsibilities
items: 2.1. Implementation of the university's human resources policy.
2.2. Processing of employment relations.
2.3. Participation in the formation of the university's HR policy, evaluation of personnel and advancement of their qualifications.

sections.title: Structure
items: 3.1. The structure and staffing of the department are approved by the university rector.
3.2. The department is headed by a manager appointed by order of the rector.
3.3. The head of the department performs administrative and executive functions and issues mandatory instructions to employees.
3.4. Employees are guided in their work by their job descriptions.

sections.title: Department Functions
Rights
items: 5.1. Obtaining necessary information within the limits of its competence.
5.2. Interaction with other departments.
5.3. Submitting proposals on personnel matters.

sections.title: Responsibility
items: 6.1. The department is responsible for the quality and timely fulfilment of its duties.
6.2. The responsibility of employees is determined by job descriptions.

sections.title: Interaction
sections.description: The Human Resources Department works closely with other departments of the university (administrative, financial, academic, etc.).
